properties.name: Peregadacs

constructionEvidence.name: Peregadacs
constructionEvidence.note: Broad low-confidence whole Peregadacs farm district south of the village, inferred from the actual Peregi dűlő access road, northern village-edge farm track, eastern highway and southern field/woodland lane network. Municipal rural-service ordinance confirms Peregadacs and an electoral address list contains many Peregadacs tanya numbers, supporting a dispersed district rather than one yard. Outer field/woodland interfaces are rough, but follow actual corridors and include the dispersed homesteads.

properties.name: Sarlósár

constructionEvidence.name: Sarlósár
constructionEvidence.note: Whole small forest-clearing farm/hamlet group at the actual three-way access junction, including adjoining northern and southern inhabited/service clearings and yards. The saved native Sarlósár label is inside Kunbaracs municipality; physical roads and forest/clearing parcel outlines provide a coarse extent. A larger namesake Sarlósár is also documented in neighboring Tatárszentgyörgy, but identity/equivalence is not established, so no cross-municipal merge is asserted and those documents are not treated as proof of this perimeter.
